notes.title: Thank you for joining the Multiplayer Open Beta!!!
notes.notes: [p]The Multiplayer Open Beta has ended. Thank you so much for all your support![/p][p]We’ll refine the experience based on your feedback and launch the full release this fall.[/p][p]It’s just a short break for now—we’ll announce the release date as soon as it’s set.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, here are the candidate features we’re exploring. Some require technical validation, so not everything may make the initial release, but we’re committed to delivering a smoother, more enjoyable, and more focus-friendly multiplayer:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Let players discover “Recently Opened Multiplayer Rooms” under Joinable Rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Allow hosts to update the room thumbnail[/p][/*][*][p]Allow hosts to write a description for the Multiplayer Room[/p][/*][*][p]Option to automatically make the room private when the host leaves[/p][/*][*][p]Clearly document conditions under which a room becomes private/closed[/p][/*][*][p]Add a “Focus Mode” so players don’t feel obligated to greet each other[/p][/*][*][p]Polish/refresh emotes[/p][/*][*][p]Inherit the host’s per-ambient-sound volume settings for participants[/p][/*][*][p]Switch to another room without exiting the Multiplayer session[/p][/*][*][p]Block feature for disruptive users[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer-related achievements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Please look forward to the release![/h3]

notes.title: “Multiplayer” Open Beta Starts Today!!!!!!!
notes.notes: [p]Thank you so much for your patience, gogh players![/p][p][/p][h3]We’ve been building “Multiplayer” for a while now,[/h3][h3]and starting today we’re running a one-week Open Beta that anyone can join‼️‼️‼️[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Multiplayer on Steam[/b][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="mCjaznWwz00;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]We’ve decided to [b]release Multiplayer[/b] in [b][u]Autumn 2025[/u][/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]This will be the biggest update since launch, and we’re incredibly excited to share it with you.[/p][p][/p][p]We haven’t really talked about what Steam’s Multiplayer will look like yet.[/p][p]The mobile version has supported multiplayer since last year, but the Steam version is taking a different approach.[/p][p]Based on all the feedback we’ve received, we’re crafting a new experience that really shines on PC.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gather in your own room—or a friend’s![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/b0b2ae9b4ee84f7c8bd0e7710e45e4a306074009.png"][/img]※ Work-in-progress screen.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Multiplayer[/b] lets you set your own room to limited access as a “Multiplayer Room” and invite other players.[/p][p]Inside a Multiplayer Room, you can show what you’re working on above your avatar and communicate with a handful of fun emotes.[/p][p]Just like on mobile, there’s no text or voice chat—so you can focus without worrying about conversation.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Open Beta runs for one week[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Starting today, we’re kicking off the Open Beta for the “Multiplayer” feature![/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[β Test Details][/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Dates: Aug 25 (Mon) – Sep 1 (Mon), ends 5:00 PM (JST)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Who can join: All players who own gogh on Steam[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]How to join: [url="https://help.gogh.gg/beta-test"]https://help.gogh.gg/beta-test[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We’d love your feedback to help us polish the experience![/h3][h3]Jump in and give it a try‼️‼️‼️[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3213850/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: [Summer Update!!] Save & Place Multiple Avatars + New Routine Feature!!!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="oUwKe8EggHY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Thanks for your patience! As previously announced—[/p][p][/p][h2]You can now Save & Place Multiple Avatars!! 🎉🎉🎉[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/9aa83e3b576d05595972fb1ac23a9ddb880bb243.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Save up to 9 customized avatars[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Place up to 9 avatars freely in your room[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Easily add, remove, or swap avatars at any time[/p][/*][*][p]Only the main avatar will work with you via the timer[/p][/*][/list][p]Try capturing your lively multi-avatar room with photos or videos!
We’re excited to see your creations in the Community Hub and on social media.[/p][p][/p][h2]New “Routine” Feature to Support Your Daily Habits 🗓️[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/278952d14dbf7ecac5413fcd7816258f2bc61803.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In addition to ToDos for task management, you can now track recurring habits like [b]“Drink 1L of water” or “Meditate for 10 minutes”[/b]—and log your progress daily![/p][p][/p][h2]New Room Style: “Brooklyn Loft”[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/2825e2a4ae0adad4f6fede013d0de01e7573eea0.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve added a new [b]“Brooklyn Loft”[/b] style to Normal-sized rooms—designed to evoke a cozy New York flat.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Playlist: “UMINEKO – Pixel Dreams”[/h2][p][/p][p]The new playlist [b]“UMINEKO – Pixel Dreams”[/b] features music by [url="“https://x.com/neko_vtuber”"]Virtual Cat[/url], bringing a fresh [b]Future Bass[/b] sound to your focus sessions.[/p][p][/p][h2]~100 New Items Added[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/8ff8df715f151fd91aaa2eec4a7d063a732e2b00.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve added sofas, king-size beds, and even Kuroda plushies![/p][list][*][p][b]~20 new avatar items[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]~80 new room items[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]4 new avatar poses[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]And yes—we plan to keep adding new items for free in future updates![/p][p]Enjoy your focused productivity life with gogh![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3213850"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Next Major Update lands July 10: Save & Place Multiple Avatars!!
notes.notes: [p]Hey gogh players—and everyone who picked us up (or is about to) in the Summer Sale![/p][p][/p][h2]Our biggest update yet lands on Thu ✦ July 10—right before the Summer Sale ends!![/h2][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s coming…[/p][p] [/p][h2]1) Save Multiple Avatars![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/c52d43ccb65fc99eb5fbeb5395880302edbadd2b.png"][/img][/p][p]No more picking just one—store up to nine avatar presets!![/p][p]Swap them on the fly or give every one of your nine rooms its own star performer.[/p][p] [/p][h2]2) Place Multiple Avatars![/h2][p][/p][h3][u]Yep—drop up to nine avatars in a single room!![/u][/h3][p]Keep your main avatar grinding while side avatars chill, cheer, or just hang out, turning your workspace into something totally fresh. [/p][p]Screenshots are about to level up—get ready for [b]a brand-new way to play[/b] and share.[/p][p]We’ll dive into the finer details as launch gets closer.[/p][p][/p][h2]3) Daily Routine Tracker![/h2][p][/p][p]If dev timing lines up, the new “Daily Routine” feature ships in the same patch![/p][p]Separate from your task-focused To-Do list, you’ll log repeatable habits—“Drink 1L of water,” “Meditate 5 min,” and so on—and tick them off each day.[/p][p] [/p][h2]4) Roughly 100 New Items![/h2][p][/p][p]And, of course, a haul of fresh content:[/p][list][*][p]New room preset: “Brooklyn Style” (Normal size)[/p][/*][*][p]≈ 20 new avatar items (planned)[/p][/*][*][p]≈ 80 new room items (planned)[/p][/*][*][p]New Future Bass playlist “UMINEKO - Pixel Dreams”[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0: Mac Support, New Productivity Tools, and Visual Refresh!
notes.notes:

We hope you’ll make gogh your new productivity companion on Mac as well.[/p][p]*1 The drag-and-drop image attachment feature for room items is not supported on Mac.[/p][p]*2 Please note that some future features may not be compatible with Mac. More improvements are coming, so please try them out and share your feedback![/p][list][*][p][b]“Focus Stats”[/b] to record daily app runtime and timer usage[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Set Deadline”[/b] feature for the To-Do list[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Label Colors”[/b] for categorizing To-Do tasks[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Clear Completed Tasks”[/b] function to batch delete finished items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Visuals Refreshed![/h3][p]With this update, we’ve [b][u]refreshed the key visuals and app icon[/u][/b].
You’ll notice a new look on the store and in your library.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also fixed some bugs related to lighting items.[/p]

notes.title: 500 Reviews & “Very Positive” — Thank You! A Fresh Look at Our Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/f42f95049c446b0d46b40978575eae5adf95d887.png[/img]
Hey, everyone!

In less than two weeks we’ve hit [b]25,000 copies sold, 500 reviews, and a “Very Positive” rating above 89 %.[/b] Your screenshots of cozy rooms and stylish avatars have been the highlight of our social-media feeds—thank you for sharing them and for playing gogh: Focus with Your Avatar.


[h2]Listening—and acting—on your feedback[/h2]

Between Steam reviews, the community hub, Discord, Google Forms, and social media, we read everything you send us. Thanks to that feedback we rolled out four hotfixes in the first ten days, including a brand-new saturation slider and other quality-of-life tweaks. The next target is better lighting—expect an update soon.


[h2]Updated Roadmap[/h2]

We posted a roadmap the day after launch. Your avalanche of great ideas made us rethink the details, so here’s an updated, more realistic plan. (Some items are still under investigation and may change.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/260a65aa95620c30158e1260b501fbad571ad770.png[/img]
[b]Already shipped[/b]
[list]
[*] Saturation slider
[*] Rotation-UI toggle in Room Edit
[*] Pose button on chairs & beds during avatar select
[*] Mute icon on master-volume slider
[*] New UI Settings menu
[*] Performance boosts & minor fixes
[/list]
[b]Phase 1 — Polish & Options[/b]
[list]
[*] Improve avatar body/clothing clipping
[*] Global lighting overhaul + user controls
[*] Researching the possibility of having different light levels per light fixture
[*] Researching the possibility of matching colors across multiple items
[*] Individual volume bars for ambient noises; more rain variants
[*] Item bug fixes, UI cleanup, new low-impact graphics options
[/list]
[b]Phase2 - New Features & Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple avatar saves
[*] Researching the possibility of placing multiple avatars in one room
[*] New focus-tool options (TBD)
[*] New room styles, room items, avatar items, playlists
[*] New weather
[/list]
[b]Phase3 - Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Feature equivalent to the mobile “Space” mode OR a “Upload/Visit Rooms” function (both under review) *Based on player feedback, we’re evaluating these two directions side by side.
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Mac support
[*] DLC
[/list]
Stick with us—gogh is only ten days old and will keep growing.


[h2]One last thing![/h2]

[b]Launch-discount ends May 14.[/b] If you’re still on the fence, now’s the perfect time to jump in.
See you in gogh!

notes.title: Is gogh’s room too small?
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Yep… we, the dev team, think so too. 😅[/h3][/b]

Originally, gogh was designed as [b]a mobile app[/b], focusing on creating a cozy and highly customizable desk space rather than a whole room.
When we started working on the Steam version, our first step was a straightforward port… but seeing it on a PC screen, yeah, it does feel pretty small.

That said, tiny rooms like this are actually quite common in Japan, so it has its own kind of charm… but since we already have a room editing system in place, we’d love to explore ways to make it even better.

[b]So, for the full version, we’re looking into adding bigger rooms![/b] 🎉

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Happy New Year + It's Nice to Meet You!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and Happy New Year! 🎉

We are ambr and we are here with gogh: Focus with Your Avatar, a new tool to help you focus on work or studying or any other tasks you need to get done! As you can see in our announcement trailer, you can make your own customizable avatar in your very own customizable space and work along with your virtual self to some great Lofi beats. 🎶

While there is a mobile version currently available, we plan to release the Steam version in the spring. 

Here are some of the minor but important updates that we’ve been working on in the past year.

You won’t have just one room where you can work… but multiple! Maybe sometimes you want to work in a library but other times you’d prefer a cozier space. With this function, you can create and save multiple rooms and switch between them to match your mood! 🌼

[previewyoutube=QfedToFS_Do;full][/previewyoutube]


As a focus tool, this game includes a pomodoro-style timer. The best part is that you can customize it to your needs! You can input the number of sessions you want to work during in one sitting and even include a “skip” button. 💃🏽


[previewyoutube=A4tjaF2CfSQ;full]https://youtu.be/A4tjaF2CfSQ[/previewyoutube]

And for those of you who love ASMR, we’re also working on the sounds that will come up when you decorate your room. Hopefully you find them satisfying enough that you’ll want to keep playing around with decorations… but don’t forget to get your work done, too! 🔉


[previewyoutube=yvoQA-R00Co;full]https://youtu.be/yvoQA-R00Co[/previewyoutube]

We hope to keep you updated regularly from now on, so make sure to add us to your Steam Wishlist to get more updates! Also, join our Discord server at [url=discord.gg/UzwwFse3gd]discord.gg/UzwwFse3gd[/url] and follow us on Bluesky at [url=https://bsky.app/profile/goghjpn.bsky.social]goghjpn.bsky.social[/url]!

See you soon! 👋
